body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Haier launched ''DF-S150'', DMB TV combining PMP with Navigation. You enjoy clear screen received from broadcasting through embedded diversity antenna and external satellite antenna. It supports electronic map with search engine and pedestrian mode including FM transmitter with a built-in 1GB Mando map. Other features are touch screen-type User Interface, TV Out and SD card slot.
